text:
Maya: Hey design team — need a set of assets for the May 6 webinar on inference economics. @Arjun can you take this? Quick list below, deadline EOD May 3.

Arjun: Yep, I can do it. Quick Qs: do you want new benchmark visuals or reuse last quarter's? Also, do we have exact numbers or should I mock? 

Maya: New visuals. We need: 1) benchmark comparison (latency vs cost vs throughput) — 3 bars; 2) simplified infra diagram (routing + cache + fallback); 3) 6 social card variants; 4) 8-slide 16:9 template + 4:5 slide repo; 5) PNG/JPEG / SVG + Figma source. Brand compliance required. Legal to sign off on any claims. Use this Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/webinar-asset-starter

Sam: Brand note — use brand tokens (redwood-500, redwood-700, slate-400) and Inter for headings, Inter/Roboto for body. Avoid using the gradient in benchmark bars; keep solid fills. I'll review color contrast.

Leah: For the infra diagram, call out: routing policy (latency/cost), KV cache, dedicated vs hosted. For benchmark labels, use model family names (e.g., open-gpt-x), not internal tags. I can validate the metric labels if you DM me the numbers.

Arjun: Got it. Proposed deliverables and rough timeline:
```
- Concept comps (3 variants) — May 1
- Final benchmark art + SVG — May 2
- Slide master (16:9 + 4:5) — May 2
- Social cards (6 sizes/variants) — May 3
- Figma handoff + export pack — May 3 EOD
```
Priority: benchmark art > slide master > social cards. 

Maya: Priority confirmed. Copy we want on slide 1: "Redwood Inference: Inference that scales — lower latency, predictable cost." CTA: "Register for the webinar — May 6". Please include a placeholder for signup link.

Arjun: One more: where do I pull the benchmark CSV from? Engineering numbers change frequently.

Deniz: I'll export the latest run to S3 and post the link here by EOD. For now use these provisional numbers: latency 45ms, cost $0.002/token, throughput 120 tok/s. I'll attach CSV: s3://redwood-artifacts/webinar/benchmark-may6.csv

Arjun: Perfect — I'll start mockups tomorrow morning. Can we do a 15-min sync at 10:30 PT to align on tone and final metrics?

Maya: 10:30 PT works. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Figma Bot: File updated by Arjun — https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/webinar-asset-starter (version: comps-2026-05-01)
